blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A two-day nationwide strike will be held next week by transport group Piston to protest rising fuel prices, its national president Mody Floranda announced Tuesday. The strike would run from Sept. 29 to 30, coinciding with another expected increase in fuel prices, Floranda said as he spoke to reporters during a rally in Quezon City.
